questions.question: Which annotation links a custom validation annotation to the class that holds its check?
questions.explanation: @Constraint(validatedBy = ...) tells the validator engine which ConstraintValidator class to run.

questions.question: Which method of ConstraintValidator holds your validation logic?
questions.explanation: isValid receives the value and a context, and returns true when the value passes.

questions.question: A hotel booking has checkIn 2030-03-04 and checkOut 2030-03-01, and @ValidStay adds its violation to the checkOut property. Which JSON key carries the message?
questions.explanation: The validator calls addPropertyNode("checkOut"), so the error is reported under the checkOut field.

questions.question: MemberRegistry already holds asha@example.com and lowercases before comparing. A request arrives with the email ASHA@example.com. What happens?
options: 400 with the message This email is already registered
questions.explanation: After lower-casing, the email matches, so isValid returns false and the client gets a 400.

questions.question: A custom annotation has message, groups and payload but no @Retention. The rule never runs. Why?
options: Without RUNTIME retention the annotation is not visible when the app runs
questions.explanation: The default retention drops the annotation before runtime, so the validator engine never sees it. Add @Retention(RUNTIME).
